response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang background, but the role requires embedded firmware development in C for LAN switches, Linux kernel source-level work, networking security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X), and native-level Japanese proficiency. The resume shows only brief C/C++ exposure (2014–2015), no Linux kernel modification experience, no networking/security protocol work, and no indication of any Japanese language ability, which is a hard requirement.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, and backend systems
Some low-latency systems experience (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput microservices at Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated Linux familiarity, CI/CD, testing culture, and open-source contributions
concerns: No native-level Japanese proficiency listed — a hard requirement for the role
Minimal C/UNIX systems experience (brief stint in 2014–2015) and no Linux kernel modification background
No embedded networking, switch, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded C / Linux kernel experience
General seniority and systems programming exposure
